<?php
enum ImmediateInt: int { case One = 1; }
enum ImmediatePure { case A; }

echo is_callable('ImmediateInt::from') ? 'string|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::class, 'tryFrom']) ? 'class-array|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::One, 'from']) ? 'case-array|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable('ImmediatePure::cases') ? 'pure-cases|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable('ImmediatePure::from') ? 'BAD|' : 'pure-no-from|';
echo is_callable('ImmediatePure::from', true) ? 'pure-syntax|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::One, 'missing']) ? 'BAD|' : 'case-no-method|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::One, 'missing'], true) ? 'case-syntax|' : 'BAD|';
echo ImmediateInt::from(1) === ImmediateInt::One ? 'cold-case|' : 'BAD|';
purpose: Published enum strings and class/case arrays, generated positives, absent-method negatives, syntax-only and cold backing table.

<?php
enum QueryBacked: int { case One = 1; }
enum QueryPure { case A; }

$callee = 'is_callable';
function change_callee(): string {
    global $callee;
    $callee = 'is_int';
    echo 'REBIND|';
    return 'QueryBacked::from';
}

echo $callee(change_callee()) ? 'selected|' : 'BAD|';
echo $callee === 'is_int' ? 'rebound|' : 'BAD|';
echo ('QueryBacked::from' |> 'is_callable') ? 'pipe-yes|' : 'BAD|';
echo ('QueryPure::from' |> 'is_callable') ? 'BAD|' : 'pipe-no|';
purpose: Dynamic callee selection before argument rebinding and pipe string query of backed and pure enums.

$ok = is_callable('MissingCheck::missing', false, $name);
echo 'runtime:', (int)$ok, ':', $name, '|';
$name = 'old';

purpose: A literal missing method on a published enum writes the output name on both false runtime and true syntax-only results.

source:
<?php
enum FirstCheck: string { case A = 'a'; }
enum OtherCheck: string { case B = 'a'; }
class NameDrop {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'NAME-DROP|'; }
}

$target = [FirstCheck::class, 'from'];
$name = new NameDrop;
echo 'before|';
$ok = is_callable($target, false, $name);
echo 'selected:', ($ok ? '1' : '0'), ':', $name, '|';
$target = [OtherCheck::B, 'tryFrom'];
echo 'rebound:', (is_callable($target) ? '1' : '0'), '|';
$same = [FirstCheck::class, 'from'];
$ok = is_callable($same, false, $same);
echo 'alias:', ($ok ? '1' : '0'), ':', $same, '|';
purpose: Array input, old-object destructor and input/output aliasing remain outside the direct literal scalar-CV output route.

<?php
enum QueryStaticMagic {
    case A;
    public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $args): mixed { return null; }
}
enum QueryInstanceMagic {
    case A;
    public function __call(string $name, array $args): mixed { return null; }
}
enum QueryUserMethod {
    case A;
    public static function from(mixed $value): self { return self::A; }
}

echo is_callable('QueryStaticMagic::from') ? 'static-from|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([QueryStaticMagic::class, 'tryFrom']) ? 'static-try|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([QueryStaticMagic::A, 'missing']) ? 'BAD|' : 'static-case-no|';
echo is_callable('QueryInstanceMagic::missing') ? 'BAD|' : 'instance-string-no|';
echo is_callable([QueryInstanceMagic::class, 'missing']) ? 'BAD|' : 'instance-class-no|';
echo is_callable([QueryInstanceMagic::A, 'missing']) ? 'instance-case|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable('QueryUserMethod::from') ? 'user-string|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([QueryUserMethod::class, 'from']) ? 'user-array|' : 'BAD|';
purpose: Receiver-specific magic fallback on published pure enums, absent generated names and explicit user method controls.
